fields.Name: IT79 - Materialized Read Served From Snapshot
fields.Description: Live-DB proof that RunQuery(DataSource:'Materialized') is served from the physical snapshot (not the live source) plus the reverse-direction delete-path FK cleanup. Fabricates a snapshot table carrying a sentinel row absent from the live source, then MR1 asserts a Materialized read returns the sentinel AND its RenderedSQL references materialized_<...> + the surrogate order key; MR2 (negative control) asserts the SAME query read Live returns the sentinel nowhere; MR3 asserts deleting the MaterializedResult with its join row present cleans the join first (no raw FK violation). Server transport (RenderedSQL stripped by the GraphQL client). Self-cleaning fixtures; SQL-Server only (skips when no mssql pool).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: A Materialized read is served from the snapshot (sentinel present + materialized_ RenderedSQL) while the same query read Live returns the sentinel nowhere, and deleting the MaterializedResult cleans its join row first. 3 checks (MR1-MR3).
